tools.name: unit_price
tools.description: Links to OutletPicks listings matching a product description, lowest cost per unit (per ml, per diaper, per page, per lb) first, with the shelf each sits on. The pages show today's Amazon price, pack size and cost per unit; the tool returns links, not prices. Use for "what should X cost" and "is this a good price", then read the page.

query.description: Product words, e.g. "aa batteries" or "dove body wash 22 oz".

tools.name: category_price
tools.description: The OutletPicks page for one category and how many listings it ranks by cost per unit. The page shows today's median, the price to treat as a good one and the cheapest listing; the tool returns the link and the count, not prices. Call with an unknown slug to get the list of categories.

tools.name: bigger_pack
tools.description: For one listing, a link to the same product in a materially different pack size that costs less per unit today, if one is listed, with its pack size. The tool returns links, not prices. Takes a deal slug: the part after /deals/ in a URL from unit_price.
